serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-unbounded-consumption-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans LLM/agent application code for Unbounded Consumption ("denial of wallet") anti-patterns from OWASP LLM Top 10 2026's #6 category -- missing output token limits, missing timeouts on hand-rolled LLM HTTP calls, unbounded agent tool-calling/retry loops, explicitly disabled framework safety limits, and MCP tool handlers with no visible rate limiting

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan LLM/agent application code for Unbounded Consumption anti-patterns.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for Unbounded Consumption / denial-of-wallet anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of LLM/agent application source for Unbounded Consumption / denial-of-wallet anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every Unbounded Consumption / denial-of-wallet pattern this auditor detects, grouped by category
